evidence_boundary: SW2-04 acceptance covers Documentation System V2 only: public-facing documentation must become concise and navigable while deterministic generated Project Truth and machine evidence remain independently auditable and drift-detectable. Existing SW2-01 through SW2-03 governance, mode-safety, and Sequence V2 guarantees are inherited authority and must not be weakened. Runtime/E2E is not applicable to this repository documentation-system phase unless stronger runtime evidence becomes necessary.
